WITH base AS (
 SELECT a.artregistry, a.artname, a.mattype, u.displaydurmonths,
  CASE s.lightsensitivity WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS lw,
  CASE s.tempsensitivity WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS tw,
  CASE s.humiditysensitivity WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS hw,
  CASE a.conservestatus WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END AS cs,
  r.histsignrating, r.researchvalrating, r.cultscore,
  l.lightlux, l.visibleexplxh
 FROM usagerecords u
 JOIN artifactscore a ON a.artregistry=u.artrefused
 JOIN sensitivitydata s ON s.sensitivityregistry=u.sensdatalink
 JOIN artifactratings r ON r.artref=u.artrefused
 JOIN conditionassessments ca ON ca.artrefexamined=u.artrefused
 JOIN lightandradiationreadings l ON l.lightradregistry=ca.lightreadrefobserved
 WHERE u.displayrotatesched='Active'
),
calc AS (
 SELECT *, 36.0*(10-lw)*(10-tw)*(10-hw)/1000.0 AS dsd,
  lightlux*lw*visibleexplxh/1000.0 AS ler,
  (histsignrating+researchvalrating+cultscore)*(10-cs)/30.0 AS cpi
 FROM base
)
SELECT artregistry, artname, mattype, displaydurmonths, round(dsd::numeric,2) dsd,
 round(((dsd-displaydurmonths)*(ler+1)*(cpi+1)/100.0)::numeric,4) erps,
 CASE WHEN (dsd-displaydurmonths)*(ler+1)*(cpi+1)/100.0 < 0 THEN 'Immediate Rotation' ELSE 'Monitor' END rec
FROM calc ORDER BY erps LIMIT 10;
